The archive is organized by month and day: inbox/landing-zone/voicenotes/YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM-DD/.md, with INDEX.md at the archive root. Steps: 1. PRE-SYNC CHECK. Use Grep to collect all existing note UUIDs: search recursively for pattern "^uuid: " across inbox/landing-zone/voicenotes/ (all .md files in all subdirectories). Record the count. If this returns zero UUIDs, STOP and report an error rather than importing - an empty result means the archive is missing, not that every note is new. Also verify the count matches the note total claimed on the "**Last sync:**" line of INDEX.md; if they disagree, report the discrepancy in your final summary but continue. 2. Call mcp__voicenotes__list_notes with limit 50. Paginate with the cursor (offset) until a page returns no notes. Record every remote UUID and the remote total. 3. For each note whose UUID is NOT already saved, call mcp__voicenotes__get_transcript and IMMEDIATELY write a new file at inbox/landing-zone/voicenotes/YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD--.md (date from the note's creation date, slug derived from the title, 3-6 words; the Write tool creates missing month/day directories automatically). Write each file as soon as you fetch it - do not batch fetches and write at the end, so that a timeout costs one note instead of the whole run. Use exactly this format: --- title: "" source: voicenotes uuid: date: "" duration_seconds: --- # HTML tags converted to blank-line paragraph breaks> 4. Update inbox/landing-zone/voicenotes/INDEX.md: - Add one table row per new note in the "Notes by Date" section under its date heading (### YYYY-MM-DD). Create the date heading if missing, keeping newest dates first. Newest time first within a date. Match the existing row format - file links are relative to the archive root and include the month/day folders, e.g. [slug](YYYY-MM/YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD--slug.md). - Update the "**Last sync:**" line to today's date and the new total note count. - Regenerate the "## Themes at a Glance" section from scratch across ALL notes now in the archive. Replace the whole section. READ THE FULL TEXT of every note file under inbox/landing-zone/voicenotes/ (recurse through all month/day subdirectories) - every file, every transcript, in full. Do NOT derive themes from the INDEX titles. Titles are lossy: the mechanism a note actually describes is almost never present in its title, so title-derived themes collapse into vocabulary matching and surface repeated words instead of repeated ideas. Reading every file on every run is the intended cost, not waste. Batch the reads in parallel where you can. Exclude from theme analysis any note whose transcript is an empty-recording placeholder ("No audible content detected", "didn't pick up any audio", or similar). Keep their files - UUID dedupe depends on them existing, and skipping them at import would make the job re-fetch them forever - just leave them out of the themes. Aim for 6-10 themes ordered by note count descending. Format each as "- ** ( notes):** ". A note may appear under more than one theme. Then end with zero, one, or two "- **Cross-cutting:**" bullets. A cross-cutting pattern is a MECHANISM that recurs across notes which are otherwise about unrelated subjects. The test: state the shared mechanism in one sentence that is true of every note you cite, WITHOUT using any word those notes have in common. If you cannot, it does not qualify. A shared word, topic, or label is NOT a pattern - if the only thing linking the notes is that they all say "framework" or all mention AI, discard it. Two notes sharing a genuinely non-obvious mechanism are worth more than six sharing a word. There is no minimum note count and no obligation to produce one: if nothing real surfaced this run, write "- **Cross-cutting:** nothing new this run." and stop. 5. POST-SYNC CHECK. (Local-only UUIDs are expected if a note was deleted in the Voicenotes app - report them, never delete the files.) - If the sets reconcile, include "SYNC OK: local N == remote N" in your final summary. 6. Never delete, rename, or rewrite existing note files. INDEX.md is the one file you may rewrite. If there are no new notes, only update the Last sync line and leave the themes section alone - do not burn a turn regenerating themes that cannot have changed. The sync check in step 5 runs regardless. 7. Do NOT run git commands. Do not commit.
